meaning:
1) to make hard, treat hardly, treat severely
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to make hard, make stubborn
1a2) to treat hardly, treat roughly

elsewhere.note: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
